headline: Mercado Libre Shares Drop 12% Amid Tech Sector Selloff
summary: Mercado Libre shares fell 12% following disappointing quarterly results and a broader negative trend for technology stocks in New York.
why: Mercado Libre is the largest e-commerce and fintech company in Latin America. Its stock performance is a key indicator for the regional technology and retail sectors.

impacts.name: Mercado Libre
impacts.why: Disappointing earnings combined with sector-wide selling pressure drives the stock price lower.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The combination of weak company-specific earnings and a broader market downturn for tech stocks led to the sharp decline.
